Data notes by year

Source: vignettes/articles/year-notes.Rmd
year-notes.Rmd

NIS layouts and coding systems vary across releases. Confirm field definitions, missing-value conventions, weights, and design guidance in the official documentation for every year in an analysis. The year ranges below describe package handling, not exhaustive HCUP release guidance.

ICD coding systems

The package treats NIS diagnosis and procedure fields before 2016 as ICD-9 and fields from 2016 onward as ICD-10. In 2015, Q1–Q3 use ICD-9 and Q4 uses ICD-10. The system argument selects which slot namespace a flag examines. Missing version indicators rely on the supplied slot schema; mixed-system shared columns are not supported. ICD-9 support remains experimental.

Quarter coverage and annualization

nis_design(annualize = TRUE) divides by the number of valid years, not a fraction of annual coverage. A partial year counts as a full year. If DQTR is available, the function warns about years without four quarters and 2015 cohorts confined to one coding era. Decide whether to exclude partial years or use another documented convention for the estimand.

Weights across the 2012 redesign

Trend analyses spanning the 2012 NIS redesign use TRENDWT for records before 2012 and DISCWT for records from 2012 onward. easyNIS supports 2012 and later and does not apply pre-2012 trend weights. Follow the HCUP NIS trend weight guidance when planning analyses that span the redesign.

2023 layout notes

The package keeps TOTCHG_2023 separate from earlier TOTCHG and notes reported changes in geography and stratum fields. These 2023 layout details are explicitly unverified against official 2023 documentation and real 2023 files. Do not assume comparability or use these notes as a substitute for checking the source documentation.

Check availability in the fixture

nis_example() creates invented records for selected years to illustrate package operations. Its rows are not a complete copy of annual layouts.

path <- nis_example(years = c(2015, 2019, 2020))
nis <- nis_open(path)
#> Experimental: years before 2016 store ICD-9-CM codes in DX1, PR1, ... slots.
#> ℹ Flag them with `system = "icd9"`; 2015 mixes ICD-9 (Q1-Q3) and ICD-10 (Q4)
#>   slots.
nis |> dplyr::count(YEAR) |> dplyr::collect()
#> # A tibble: 3 × 2
#>    YEAR     n
#>   <int> <int>
#> 1  2019    96
#> 2  2015    96
#> 3  2020    96

The summary confirms only that the synthetic fixture contains the requested years. It does not validate a source year’s fields or represent the real annual file.

Common pitfalls

Common pitfalls

  • Pooling years without year-scoped hospital and stratum identifiers.
  • Treating 2015 as a single-code-system year.
  • Assuming fields and coding rules remain unchanged across all releases.
  • Treating package handling of a year as official HCUP documentation.

See Survey design and weighting, Code transitions and sensitivity, nis_open(), and nis_design().
